snippet.title: September 20th Sunday Service
snippet.description:
Today we begin a brand new series, Pursing Joy: A Journey Through Philippians.

Our natural response in tough circumstances can often be to become disappointed or discouraged. But in the book of Philippians, Paul writes from prison to encourage a church he helped plant.

Today we will look at how partnership with the local church can be one of the greatest sources of joy in our lives!

Invite a friend or family member and join us!

snippet.title: September 6th Online Service
snippet.description:
Have you experienced a “mean Christian” recently? Do you find yourself only being empathic towards certain people?

In this service (originally aired on Sept. 6th), we continue our series “A New Normal” by examining the topic of Empathy. When you examine the emotional life of Jesus two things become very clear: He was empathic and compassionate towards EVERYONE. Today lead pastor Bryan Mowrey helps us understand how to be more like Jesus in this way.

Need prayer? We'd love to connect! Just text "PRAY" to (314) 926-1800 and we'll connect you with someone who can pray with you.

snippet.title: August 23rd Sunday Service
snippet.description:
Feeling weary from everything going on in the world? Are you looking for a sense of normalcy?

Today we welcome our friend Donnie Griggs from North Carolina! Donnie leads a multisite church called “One Harbor” and is also the author of the book “Small Town Jesus: Taking the Gospel Mission Seriously in Seemingly Unimportant Places.” Donnie’s churches are also a part of our extended Newfrontiers International family.

Invite a friend or family member and join us!

#myjubileechurch #onlineservices #everyoneeveryplace #oneharbor #smalltownjesus

snippet.title: August 16th Sunday Service
snippet.description:
Has 2020 felt like one long trial? Do difficult times make you question the faithfulness of God?

Today we wrap up our series “Behind Enemy Lines” by examining the faithfulness of God, and how Daniel and his friends responded to a trial that threatened their lives. Did they succumb to the pressures of the world, or trust that God would be faithful even when it seemed impossible?

Invite a friend or family member and join us!

#myjubileechurch #behindenemylines #onlineservices #everyoneeveryplace

snippet.title: August 9th Sunday Service
snippet.description:
Are you feeling overwhelmed by all that’s wrong with the world? Do you wonder what you can do to help or grow?

Join us as we wrap up our series "Unshaken" by being reminded of the vision God has for His kingdom and some steps we can take to grow in these areas. 

Invite a friend or family member and join us as we continue to seek to become more like Jesus!

#myjubileechurch #unshaken #everyoneeveryplace

snippet.title: August 2nd Sunday Service
snippet.description:
Have you ever experienced someone trying to change you by shaming you? Or have you found yourself attempting to use shame to get your point across?

This Sunday we will continue our series "Unshaken" by examining the role of shame in the story of the woman at the well. This story helps us understand the heart of God for those who are broken and ashamed and shows us how we are called to love those same people.

Invite a friend or family member and join us as we continue to seek to become more like Jesus!

#myjubileechurch #unshaken #shame

snippet.title: July 26th Sunday Service
snippet.description:
Do you have firsthand experience of what its like to live as a member of the minority culture? Or have you experienced what it feels like to be marginalized or oppressed?

Today we pick back up in our series “Behind Enemy Lines” by examining how Daniel and his friends responded in the face of being marginalized and oppressed while living as members of a minority culture.  

Invite a friend or family member and join us!

#myjubileechurch #behindenemylines #onlineservices #everyoneeveryplace

snippet.title: July 19th Sunday Service
snippet.description:
How would you define your allegiances to things such as race, culture, ideologies, or even Christ? Do you believe that God’s word can shake you free from man-made allegiances so your devotion to Him can be pure and sincere?

Today we continue our series “Unshaken.” We’ll continue looking the story of the woman at the well, and dive even deeper the heart of God and the power His word has. 

Invite a friend or family member, and join us this morning!

#myjubileechurch #unshaken #livingword

snippet.title: July 5th Sunday Service
snippet.description:
Do you find it hard to rationalize how God can be loving and allow suffering? Do seasons of suffering draw you closer or push you away from God?

Today we continue our “Family Friends” series with Andrew Wilson. Andrew is the teaching pastor at King’s Church London, and has some powerful truths to share with us today.

Invite a friend or family member, and join us this morning!

#myjubileechurch #familyfriends #suffering

snippet.title: June 21st Sunday Service
snippet.description:
Do you find it challenging to live in our modern culture while also living for God?

Join us today as Elder Greg Nelson continues us our series “Behind Enemy Lines.” We will examine how Daniel and his friends were able to live within a foreign culture while continue to live for and honor God.

Grab a family member or roommate, invite or share with a friend, and join in with us!

#myjubileechurch #behindenemylines #onlineservice

snippet.description:
Join us as we continue our Family Friends series!
We will be joined by Tope Koleoso from Jubilee Church London and will celebrate another baptism as well!
We can't wait for you all to join us!

#myjubileechurch #familyfriends #baptism

snippet.title: June 7th Sunday Service
snippet.description:
We are breaking away this weekend from our current series to address the Bible's vision and our pursuit of racial reconciliation.
"One new man" was a phrase coined by the apostle Paul to describe the work of Christ on the cross to destroy hostility between races and create one new humanity. 
It is hard to face the truth, but the truth that the gospel gives us not only shows where we come up short, but empowers us to be different.
#myjubileechurch #onenewman

Check out a sermon from our series in Acts: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0L1bmMru4DE

snippet.title: May 31st Sunday Service
snippet.description:
Do you struggle with the up and down, side to side nature of our world? Do you sometimes find it difficult to stand firm in your faith during seasons of trial?

Join us today as we kick off our new series “Family Friends.” "Your Epic Calling" is a message by PJ Smyth (https://www.pjsmyth.com/), pastor and leader of the Advance Movement of Churches (https://www.advancemovement.com/).

Grab a family member or roommate, invite or share with a friend, and join in with us!

#myjubileechurch #familyfriends #onlineservice

snippet.title: May 24th Sunday Service
snippet.description:
Feel like you’ve screwed up and deserve whatever life my hand you? Or maybe you wonder if you’ll ever be free like habitual sin?
Today we begin a new series from the book of Daniel entitled “Behind Enemy Lines.” Elder Greg Nelson kicks us off by looking at the first chapter of Daniel, and we also take a moment to celebrate the graduates among us!
Join us this morning as we worship and celebrate all the God is doing!
#myjubileechurch #behindenemylines #daniel

snippet.title: May 17th Sunday Service
snippet.description:
Do you feel like God is far off and uninterested with or even angry at you? Or do you sometimes struggle with what your purpose in life is?
Join us this morning as lead pastor Bryan Mowrey continues us in our series entitled "Loving Like Jesus.” Today we will examine the story of Jesus washing the disciples’ feet, and what the implications are for us today.
Grab a family member or roommate, invite or share with a friend, and join in with us!
#myjubileechurch #lovinglikejesus #onlineservice

snippet.title: May 10th Mother's Day Service
snippet.description:
Happy Mother’s Day!

Join us for a special online Sunday service where we celebrate the mother’s in our lives. Motherhood can take on so many forms, many of which can often be thankless. But today we stop to remember and thank all the mother’s among us, both biological and spiritual.

To help us do this, our service today features a panel of some amazing women from Jubilee discussing the need for and importance of spiritual mothers.

#myjubileechurch #jubileemoms #mothersday

snippet.title: May 3rd Sunday Service
snippet.description:
Do you sometimes struggle to love others? What is your model for determining whether or not you’re loving well?

This morning we begin a new series entitled "Loving Like Jesus. Lead pastor Bryan Mowrey kicks us off as we see that by letting go of preference, privilege, and power, we are able to grow in loving others.
